m_treehouse.title: The Treehouse
m_treehouse.text: A small wooden door. A blanket fort lit by a flashlight. A voice, gentle, promising that no matter what happened downstairs, in here they would always be safe.

m_porch.title: The Porch
m_porch.text: Two kids on a cold porch step, sharing one coat. 'I've got you,' the older one whispered. Someone learned, very early, how to be the safe place for someone else.

m_kitchen.title: The Kitchen Doorway
m_kitchen.text: A child in a doorway, learning the rhythm of the house — when it was safe to speak, when it was safer to go quiet and small. The first time someone steady stepped forward so the child wouldn't have to.
